claims.claim: a Mendelian randomisation, colocalisation and transcriptomic study proposes CXCR1 and CXCR2 as neutrophil extracellular trap-related treatment targets in UC
claims.quote: CXCR1 and CXCR2 are potential neutrophil extracellular trap-related treatment targets in ulcerative colitis: insights from Mendelian randomization, colocalization and transcriptomic analysis.
claims.reason: Paper title states exactly this.

claims.claim: another study ties the CXCL5 to CXCR2 axis to neutrophil chemotaxis
claims.quote: Enrichment and immune infiltration analysis indicated that the CXCL5/CXCR2 axis was involved in neutrophil chemotaxis and immune activation in UC.
claims.reason: Sentence links CXCL5/CXCR2 to neutrophil chemotaxis.

claims.claim: The cited IDO1 support is one experimental study
claims.reason: All three IDO1 relations come from the same paper, PMID 40370742.

claims.claim: IDO1 was elevated in UC patients and colitis mice
claims.quote: The results indicated that IDO1 expression was significantly elevated in UC patients and correlated with M1 macrophage polarization observed in both human data and colitis mice.
claims.reason: Elevation in UC patients stated; mouse colitis data reported alongside.

claims.claim: IDO1 drove pro-inflammatory macrophage polarisation through the GRP78-XBP1 pathway
claims.quote: IDO1 induced macrophage M1 polarization via ER stress-associated GRP78-XBP1 pathway to promote ulcerative colitis progression.
claims.reason: Sentence states M1 polarization via GRP78-XBP1.

claims.claim: an IDO1 inhibitor ameliorated DSS colitis
claims.quote: Furthermore, 1-MT markedly ameliorated DSS-induced weight loss, colonic shortening and disease severity via inhibiting IDO1 expression level, downregulating GRP78-XBP1 pathway and reducing M1 proportion.
claims.reason: 1-MT is the IDO1 inhibitor; it ameliorated DSS colitis.

claims.claim: MMP1 is among the transcripts modified by mirikizumab that correlate with the modified Mayo score, Geboes score and Robarts Histopathology Index
claims.quote: Transcripts significantly modified by mirikizumab correlate with key UC disease activity indices (modified Mayo score, Geboes Score, Robarts Histopathology Index) and include MMP1, MMP3, S100A8, and IL1B.
claims.reason: Sentence names MMP1 among these transcripts.

claims.claim: CHI3L1 is upregulated in UC
claims.quote: CHI3L1 was significantly upregulated in UC patients and strongly correlated with NLR Family Pyrin Domain Containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome expression.
claims.reason: Direct statement of upregulation in UC patients.

claims.claim: CHI3L1 promotes macrophage pyroptosis through BCAT1 and NF-kappaB
claims.quote: CHI3L1 promotes macrophage pyroptosis in ulcerative colitis via the BCAT1/NF-kappaB axis.
claims.reason: Title sentence states this.

claims.claim: DUOX2 protein is among the most elevated in inflamed UC biopsies
claims.quote: Proteins most highly elevated in inflamed UC biopsies relative to HC were those encoded by the HLA-DRA (P = 3.1 x 10-33) and CD74 (P = 1.6 x 10-27), genes associated with antigen presentation, and the antimicrobial dual oxidase 2 (DUOX2) (P = 3.2 x 10-28) and lipocalin-2 (P = 2.2 x 10-26) genes.
claims.reason: DUOX2 protein among most highly elevated.

claims.claim: HMGCS2 is reported decreased in UC
claims.quote: Furthermore, the expressions of AQP8 and HMGCS2 decreased, whereas that of VNN1 increased.
claims.reason: Paper reports HMGCS2 decreased in UC colon.

claims.claim: The CXCL8 axis with its receptors takes part in UC pathogenesis through PI3K/Akt, MAPK and NF-kappaB signalling
claims.quote: The CXCL8-CXCR1/2 axis participates in the pathogenesis of UC through multiple signaling pathways, including PI3k/Akt, MAPKs and NF-kappaB signaling pathways.
claims.reason: Sentence states this.

claims.claim: in a blood RNA-seq validation set CXCL8 was among the best diagnostic genes for IBD, second to ITGA5
claims.quote: Validation with blood RNA-seq data (GSE169568, n = 205) showed ITGA5 (AUC: 0.856) and CXCL8 (AUC: 0.786) had the highest diagnostic performance.
claims.reason: ITGA5 0.856, CXCL8 0.786, the two highest.

claims.claim: the CXCL8 result is IBD-level rather than UC-specific
claims.reason: Relation is annotated to IBD; study pooled Crohn's disease and UC.

claims.claim: CXCL1 is nominated as a diagnostic or activity marker in several bioinformatic studies
claims.quote: CONCLUSION: S100A8, IL-1B, CXCL1, TCN1, MMP10, GREM1, DUOX2 and SLC6A14 have been identified as credible potential biomarkers for the diagnosis and therapy of UC.
claims.reason: CXCL1 named as biomarker in this and two other cited studies.

claims.claim: CXCL1 alone is only a fair activity marker
claims.reason: AUC 0.710 alone is modest, lowest of the four markers.

claims.claim: CXCL1's high accuracy comes within a combined multi-gene model
claims.quote: while their combined diagnostic model achieved an AUC of 0.989
claims.reason: CXCL1 individually AUC above 0.7, combined model 0.989.
